skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — create a talking avatar video from my script using a free HeyGen-style AI...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Generator Free HeyGen — easily create AI presenter videos from scripts, without requiring HeyGen accounts or editing skills.

- Generate talking AI avatar videos from text/scripts in 1–2 minutes, using cloud GPU rendering (no installation needed).
- Supports TXT, DOCX, MP4, MOV uploads up to 200MB.
- Simple onboarding: automatic authentication and session setup with free anonymous tokens.
- Handles common user intents (generate video, upload, export, check credits/status) via natural language prompts.
- Exports 1080p MP4 (and other formats), delivers download links directly.
- User guidance and robust error handling for seamless video creation.
